items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: There’s a Eddie Harris fan club, we all get together and talk about it.

ctx.x: “I Need Some Money.” You know it’s like you just put it out there.

Yeah. You know I never got to meet him personally, unfortunately. Because there’s a small group of us who were big Eddie Harris fans. David Hazeltine, the great pianist, he played with Eddie for a bit. Johnny King is another great pianist. He’s another Eddie Harris fan. And a young tenor player by the name of Mark Turner. There’s a Eddie Harris fan club, we all get together and talk about it. Yeah, I just can’t say enough about it man. Just a true genius. Could play anything. Could play anything. And master of…
Well I have one more thing here which I’m sure you’ll recognize.
